svg.title: About
svg.desc: I build billing systems for AI infrastructure at CoreWeave — mostly Go on Kubernetes: services, APIs, the meters and ledgers finance trusts. Earlier: AWS boto3 (Python), then backend at The New York Times. NYC native. Not an OSS celebrity — just someone who ships reliable systems.
